tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Keyword search over The Wiley Rule's public research library (288 studies on 7-OH, kratom alkaloids, MGPI and related products). Returns titles, authors, year, type, one-line summaries and links.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Full public record for one study from the research library, by id (e.g. 'pmid-40373645'), PMID or DOI.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products on The Wiley Rule's public product pages. Only sourced claims are returned: lab or forensic test results, FDA warning letters and court filings, each with its source document. No retailer or store information.

tools.name: state_actions
tools.description: State bans, scheduling and rules on concentrated 7-OH and kratom alkaloids (public sources). Pass a state (two-letter code or name) or omit for all states the site tracks.

tools.name: bill_status
tools.description: Status of tracked legislation and rulemaking: NC bills (e.g. HB 328), DEA scheduling notices, FDA actions. Optional keyword filter.

tools.name: nc_legislation
tools.description: North Carolina bills and actions the site tracks, plus NC's current status in the state table.

tools.name: find_my_lawmakers
tools.description: North Carolina only: from a 5-digit ZIP, find the NC House and Senate districts (Census ZIP-area center point) and the public office pages of those members, with any public record of their position. ZIPs can cross districts, so confirm with the official lookup.

tools.name: who_supports
tools.description: Public officials with a public record of supporting action on concentrated 7-OH (votes, sponsorship, statements) or who told The Wiley Rule they support it. Name, office, district, party and evidence label only.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Most recent public news and official notices the site tracks (Federal Register, FDA, DEA, state actions, press).

tools.name: key_dates
tools.description: Upcoming dates that matter: DEA orders, NC votes, federal comment deadlines.

tools.name: about_wiley_rule
tools.description: What The Wiley Rule is, its mission, its one-line rule, legal status, how to contact it, how to report a product, and the history behind the name (Harvey Wiley).
